summary: @ornikar/eslint-config-node 12.2.5 ships preinstall dropper that fetches Bun runtime and executes obfuscated bundled payload
details: Version 12.2.5 of this ESLint configuration package adds a preinstall lifecycle hook (`preinstall: node setup.mjs` in package.json) that fires automatically on `npm install`. setup.mjs downloads the Bun runtime from GitHub releases (oven-sh/bun v1.3.13), extracts it, chmods the binary to 0755, and execFileSyncs it against math_init.js — a ~727KB file shipped in the tarball, marked `// @bun @bun-cjs`, containing heavy string-array-rotation obfuscation (a WV8StW rotator over a ~1200-entry n7gIxM constant table with mangled identifiers). The payload is not human-inspectable and is not referenced by index.js or any of the package's plugin exports. An ESLint configuration package has no legitimate purpose that requires fetching a second language runtime at install time to execute an obfuscated bundled payload. Prior versions of this package have no install lifecycle, and setup.mjs/math_init.js are unrelated to the advertised ESLint configuration surface — consistent with a hijacked-maintainer publish delivering an alternate-runtime dropper.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
